Create an Off-Cycle Payslip for One Employee

User manual · English · 10 steps
Learn how to create a payslip outside the regular monthly run for a single employee, for example to pay a correction or a late payment, and compute it.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. All Payslips

Click All Payslips.

4. New payslip

Click New to create a payslip.

5. Employee

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

6. Choose the employee

Click the result you want in the list.

7. Salary structure

Click here to open the list of salary structures.

8. Choose the structure

Click the result you want in the list.

9. Save

Click the save icon to keep the payslip.

10. Compute Sheet

Click Compute Sheet to calculate the payslip.
